TEXT.English: Through careful political machinations, agents from the colonies of the New Worlds and even some of the more sophisticated Alien Empires could attract the allegience of powerful members of Earth's scientific, corporate, media, and political elites. Even those highly placed in the traditional hierarchies of power were increasingly drawn to the frontier of the New Worlds as the stagnation and decay of the Earthbound estabishment became rapidly more apparent.

[TAB]These ruminant mammals are widely distributed, often savage and difficult to hunt, but with edible flesh nonetheless.

[TAB]With the alien soils and CO2-poor atmosphere of the New Worlds unfavorable to the traditional high-yield food crops of Earth, many colonists turned to orbital hydroponics for a rich and sustainable food supply. Using platforms with the correct orbit and configuration, an astronaut could reap rich harvests from sunlight unfiltered by the New Worlds' alien atmosphere.

[TAB]For the wealthier nations of Earth, the development of nuclear fusion was a partial answer to the dual problems presented by the peak oil crisis and worsening global warming. However, the technology is not as efficient as had been hoped, and requires a steady input of radioactive metals, which are now becoming depleted from Earth's crust. Upon the discovery of the New Worlds, throngs of Uranium Miners journeyed forth in search of fresh deposits of radioactive fuel. They were soon joined by enterprising Physicists, hoping to break Earth's monopoly on the refining of raw Uranium into functioning Fusion Cores.
